title: Smallness of objects in a Grothendieck category
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian]. For an object $M$ of $\mathcal A$ its *size* $|M|$ is the cardinality of the set of subobjects of $M$. Let $M$ be an object of $\mathcal A$ and $\alpha$ an ordinal whose cofinality is greater than $|M|$. Then $M$ is $\alpha$-small with respect to monomorphisms: for every system $(B_\beta)_{\beta<\alpha}$ in $\mathcal A$ indexed by $\alpha$ whose transition maps $B_\beta\to B_{\beta'}$ ($\beta\le\beta'<\alpha$) are monomorphisms, every morphism $M\to\operatorname{colim}_{\beta<\alpha}B_\beta$ factors through $B_\beta\to\operatorname{colim}_{\beta<\alpha}B_\beta$ for some $\beta<\alpha$.
